summary: Summarizes how hashes are used in many Internet protocols and discusses how newly found collision attacks do or do not affect them. It shows how to thwart known attacks on digital certificates and outlines directions for protocol designers. It is informational.

eli5.summary: Hashes are like fingerprints for data. When researchers found ways to make two things share one fingerprint, people worried. This memo checks which protocols are really at risk.

questions: do hash collisions break internet protocols
